text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—And then, Craft was half-asleep
and mistook me for her mother.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, so cute♪
What's it like? What's it like?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean... like...
"M-Mooom... five more minutes..."
...or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm really terrible at impressions... Please forgive me.
